results.title: Bombay Rose
results.overview: Amidst the bustle of a magnetic and multifaceted city, the budding love between two dreamers is tested by duty and religious divides.

results.title: Chillar Party
results.overview: A gang of innocent but feisty kids who lead carefree lives in Chandan Nagar colony, take on the big bad world of politics when one of their friend's life is endangered.

results.title: Josh
results.overview: Two gangs fight for control of the streets: the Scorpions, led by Prakash and the Eagles, fronted by Max. When Prakash's brother Rahul comes to visit, he meets and quickly falls in love with Shirley, not realizing she's the sister of his brother's rival, Max. Though Rahul tries to keep their relationship secret, it's only a matter of time before it brings the gang rivalry to a head.

results.title: Angrezi Medium
results.overview: When his daughter decides to further her studies in London, a hardworking Haryanvi businessman does everything in power to make her dreams come true.

results.title: Ishaqzaade
results.overview: While fighting for the political supremacy of their respective families, a Hindu man and a Muslim woman share a forbidden romance.

results.title: The Dirty Picture
results.overview: After running away from home in search of movie stardom, a village girl rises to become a prominent sex symbol.

results.title: Pagalpanti
results.overview: 3 men, considered as losers in their lives by the people, plan to get rich along with their girlfriends by fooling 2 gangsters and robbing their money.

results.title: Trapped
results.overview: A man gets stuck in an empty high rise without food, water or electricity.

results.title: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!
results.overview: Lovinder Singh, a thief now in custody and facing trial, reflects on his life of crime while the press reflect on how he managed to get away with so much before being arrested.

results.title: Karwaan
results.overview: Avinash, a dejected soul stuck in a dead-end job shares a strange relationship with his father. He holds him responsible for crushing his dreams. However, he is left pondering upon this longstanding hatred when he hears of his father’s untimely demise.

results.title: Pari
results.overview: Arnab tries to help Ruksahana, who is found under mysterious circumstances in a house. He lets her stay at his home until he discovers something strange about her.

results.title: Golmaal 3
results.overview: Cupid strikes when Pritam, a single father, comes across his college sweetheart, Geeta, in Goa. However, when their respective children go to war with each other, the two find it difficult to reunite.

results.title: Mili
results.overview: Mili Naudiyal, a nursing graduate is planning to move to Canada. She takes up a job at a food outlet for the time being but her sudden disappearance without a clue leaves her loved ones in a desperate search for her in this survival drama.

results.title: Yes Boss
results.overview: Rahul Joshi wants to be a successful businessman so he works hard for his boss Siddharth. One day Rahul meets Seema, an up and coming model, and he feels like he's finally met his match. Will Seema fall for Rahul?

results.title: Shivaay
results.overview: Shivaay , a fearless Himalayan mountaineer covered in Lord Shiva tattoos, heads to Bulgaria to fulfill his nine-year-old daughter Gaura’s  wish of seeing her mother Olga, who abandoned them years ago. But their plan goes for a toss when the little girl gets kidnapped in the foreign land. Rescuing her from the masked child-traffickers becomes his only reason for survival.

results.title: Street Dancer 3D
results.overview: Two rival dance groups from India and Pakistan who are always competing against each other, join forces when it comes to competing at an international dance competition.

results.title: Force 2
results.overview: ACP Yashvardhan teams up RAW Agent KK to bring down the master mind terrorist, Shiv.

results.title: Jannat 2
results.overview: Sonu Dilli KKC, an illegal arms dealer is chased around by ACP Pratap Raghuvanshi. On the other hand, Sonu falls for Dr Jhanvi Singh Tomar. However, Sonu's life is turned upside-down, when he realises that Dr Jhanvi is the daughter of Mangal Singh Tomar, an illegal arms kingpin. Will Sonu survive the difficult times ahead?

results.title: Gold
results.overview: Set in 1948, the historic story of India's first Olympic medal post their independence.

results.title: Rustom
results.overview: A naval officer is devastated to learn about his wife's extramarital affair with a rich businessman while he was away. He pays him a visit and shoots him to death, following which he surrenders himself but claims to be "not guilty" in the court, much to the surprise of the businessman's sister and the officers dealing with his case.
